rationale: Degree-split Poseidon AIR: store per-round intermediates, reduce degree 10→4. Papers: Setty ePrint 2019/550 §4, Gabizon et al. 2019/953 §8.
diagnostic: +64 columns (110→174) increased per-evaluation cost by ~58%, overwhelming the 36% fewer evaluation points (11→7). Stacked cells went 627M→761M. The column-cost dominates because each sumcheck round folds ALL column data at EACH evaluation point — more columns = multiplicatively more work per point.

rationale: Huge page arena: MAP_HUGETLB with MADV_HUGEPAGE fallback. Papers: Basu et al. ISCA 2013, Panwar et al. ASPLOS 2019.
diagnostic: MAP_HUGETLB fails (160 GiB region > 12 GiB pool). MADV_HUGEPAGE fallback: THP doesn't promote pages due to demand paging with MAP_NORESERVE — khugepaged too slow (10s scan interval) for 2-9s workload. MADV_COLLAPSE fails on sparse slabs (EINVAL). Net: no TLB improvement on this hardware.

rationale: Karatsuba MDS in SIMD permute path. Papers: Grassi et al. 2019/458 §5.2, Harvey 2014 §3. Plonky3 uses Karatsuba.
diagnostic: Karatsuba is SLOWER than FFT on AVX-512 (+1.8%). FFT butterflies have superior ILP — independent pairs within each radix stage map perfectly to 16-wide SIMD lanes. Karatsuba's recursive halve-split-recurse-recombine creates sequential dependencies that limit SIMD utilization.

rationale: 4-ary Merkle tree. Papers: Merkle CRYPTO 1987, Grassi et al. 2019/458 §6.
diagnostic: DIGEST_LEN_FE=8 is deeply embedded in XMSS protocol layout, fiat-shamir proof format, and merkle_pruning reconstruction. Changing to 4 breaks XMSS data packing (overlapping fields). Would need full decoupling of WHIR Merkle digest from protocol-level digest — too large a refactor for this arc.

rationale: calloc_vec for WHIR combined_weights — bypass Clone init with alloc_zeroed.
diagnostic: Compiler already optimizes vec![T::ZERO; len] to memset-equivalent for bitwise-zero types. alloc_zeroed is no faster than the existing path. The 9.4% in zero_vec shown in perf was from the perf call-graph sampling (callee attribution), not actual zeroing cost.

rationale: Enable THP via prctl(PR_SET_THP_DISABLE,0) + remove MADV_NOHUGEPAGE. Papers: Basu ISCA 2013, Panwar ASPLOS 2019.
diagnostic: THP compaction catastrophe: dTLB dropped 49%→3% but THP defrag=[always] causes synchronous memory compaction on every page fault, adding ~1.9s (87%) to proving time. MADV_NOHUGEPAGE was deliberately set to avoid this. Would need defrag=defer (kernel tuning, out of scope).

rationale: THP pre-fault via MADV_POPULATE_WRITE + NOHUGEPAGE sandwich.
diagnostic: MADV_NOHUGEPAGE after pre-fault splits the huge pages back to 4KB. The sandwich approach doesn't preserve huge pages.
dTLB misses are cold-start only; warm proofs reuse already-mapped pages regardless of page size. The 49.5% dTLB miss includes cold start; warm proofs have <10% dTLB misses inherently.
